product_metadata.title: Mandy's 20pcs Orange Flowers Artificial Calla Lily Silk Flowers 13.4" for Mother's Day Home Kitchen & Wedding
features: Materials: Flower is made of soft Polyurethane (PU), stem is made of Plastic.
Size: Full height: 13.5”/35cm; Each flower head diameter:3”/8cm. Including 20pcs calla lilies per pack and vase not included.
Our designer uses the color of fresh flowers as a reference to enrich the color of our artificial calla lilies as much as possible to make them look more real.
In order to make the calla lily feel more like a real flower, we used high-quality polyurethane as the material.

Calla lilies are a must-have choice at the wedding party. Either use them as the bridal bouquet or put them as the centerpieces on the table or DIY your own brooch. Use your imagination to create a romantic wedding party that belongs to you. One most important thing, after wedding party, you may keep the bouquet or brooch as the souvenir. At your more years anniversary, looking for your memorable days with your lover.
Calla Lily are beautiful flowers as Mother's Day gifts. When you received a flower bouquet from your son or daughter, It does a beautiful Mom's Day.
If you want these flowers to look like growing in water, you may put them in a glass vase with water. Good choice for home centerpieces.

Make of your own bouquet. You may put calla, tulips or roses together, make a beautiful bouquet. Use the flower packing outside the bouquet, it will be a good gift for your mother, father friends and everyone you loved.
Put calla lilies on the Christmas tree or as the special event decoration, it’s also a good choice.
Applicable for: Home, office, shop, party, garden, centerpiece, Wedding, and special events.
